# Yousef (p08) journal

## Day 1 (Sun 2026-10-04)
- Setup was OK. Weight from the profile became today's weigh-in (91.6) automatically - nice, but I wasn't sure at first whether I also had to add it with "+ Weight". Saw it in "Recent entries", so fine.
- The "eating at roughly your current intake for 2+ weeks?" question made me think. I'm starting a diet now, so I said "No / not sure".
- After setup the Nutrition target said "maintain" (2,890). I had to hunt for the gear icon to set "Lose". Setup never asked me my goal - expected it to. After Lose 0.5%/wk: target 2,420, maintenance 2,890 ± 680 "Estimated".
- ±680 is a huge range. Not sure what to do with that.
- Food log: "Add entry" appears twice (heading + button), fine. Noticed the "Water events" tags at the bottom: High salt, Creatine start - useful for me (Thursday restaurant, creatine later).
- Logged 4 meals = 2,018 kcal, ticked "Day complete".

## Day 2 (Mon)
- Scale 92.1, UP 0.5 kg after one day of dieting. Stressed. Home screen showed "▲ 0.5 kg" in the weight card. Trend line says 91.6 though, which calmed me a bit - but nothing on screen says "don't worry, one day is water".
- I tapped "Weight" expecting to add a weigh-in and got the "Weight trend" chart instead (tapped the card). The add button is "+ Weight" at the bottom. Small confusion.
- Ate 2,662 today (burger + pizza) - above the 2,420 target. The app doesn't show me "you're over by X today" anywhere on the Nutrition screen; I had to do the math myself from the food log "Day total".
- Recommendation box still says "needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)" even though it's day 2. Probably because it only refreshes Sundays, but it reads as wrong.

## Day 3 (Tue)
- 91.7, down from 92.1. But home card said "▲ 0.1 kg" - it compares to my FIRST weigh-in by default. I found the "vs First / vs Last" switch and changed to vs Last -> "▼ 0.4 kg". Felt better. The default made it look like I was still up.
- 2,201 kcal, under target. Marked complete.

## Day 4 (Wed)
- 91.6. The vs First/vs Last switch went back to "vs First" overnight - it doesn't remember my choice. Card showed "• 0 kg" (same as first day).
- 2,317 kcal. New hint on Nutrition: "Protein averaged 154 g on 4 logged days vs 165 g target" - OK, I should eat a bit more protein. Useful.

## Day 5 (Thu) - restaurant night
- 91.5. Breakfast I didn't know macros - just calories worked fine ("no macros"). Snack only protein - fine.
- Once one meal has no macros, the "Day total" line stops showing protein/carbs/fat for the whole day. Slightly annoying, I'd like to see the protein I DID log.
- Salty restaurant dinner: I remembered the "High salt" chip from day 1 and tapped it. Only a subtle highlight shows it's on (screens/1790457613866.png) - I wasn't 100% sure it was selected until I saw "1 tag" in the Last 14 days list.
- 2,086 kcal, complete.

## Day 6 (Fri)
- 91.6. Only +0.1 after the salty dinner, so no panic. Still basically where I started after 6 days though (card says "• 0 kg" vs first). A bit discouraging.
- 2,267 kcal logged, complete. Protein avg now 150 vs 165 target.

## Day 7 (Sat)
- 90.6! Down 1 kg in a day. Card "▼ 1 kg", trend 91.5. Happy, but I know it's probably water from yesterday.
- Ate only 1,559 today. "Explain the math" says "Minimum suggested: 1,865 kcal/day" but nothing warned me when my day total was under that. (Maybe it only looks at averages.)
- Opened "Explain the math" (screens/1790457695729.png ... 1790457700662.png). Way too much math for me (Kalman filter, Forbes, MAD...). What I got: maintenance 2,890 is from a formula, my data is 0% so far, target = 2,890 - 468 = 2,422. Text glitches: "7 day s", "7 daily weight s", "( day 1 )" - spaces inside words.
- Section 2 says 7 weigh-ins used, but section 8 says cross-check "needs ≥ 7 weigh-ins in the last 28 days" - I HAVE 7. Confusing (maybe because numbers are frozen from Sunday's update).

## Week 1 (Sun 2026-10-11, day 8)
- App said: maintenance 2,900 ± 670 kcal/day, "Estimated", 3% from my data. Target 2,440 (lose 0.5%/wk). My avg intake 2,182, weight change -0.93 kg/week (95%: -2.49 to 0.63). Protein 141 g vs 165 g target. No warnings. On-track check "needs 14 days".
- Body composition breakdown: "Not enough data yet" (needs BIA/DEXA/caliper readings; I only have a normal scale). It says waist is the main fat signal - maybe I should measure waist, but I won't bother.
- What I understood: the app thinks I burn ~2,900 but it's mostly still a guess. I'm eating less than it suggests and losing faster than planned. The ±670 range is so wide I don't fully trust the number.
- Decision: plan 2,300/day - a bit more food, mostly protein, but I'm not going all the way to 2,440 because I don't want the scale to jump.
- Weekly numbers did change today: target 2,420 -> 2,440 (weird that target went UP while I'm losing).

## Days 9-14 (scripted routine: weigh, log 4 meals, tag High salt on Thursday, mark complete)
- Weights: 90.6, 90.1, 90.2, 90.5 (Thu), 91.2 (Fri, after 3,138 kcal salty restaurant day - +0.7 kg jump, my heart sank), 90.6. Trend line stayed calm at 91.1 through the jump, which helped. Nothing on screen explicitly said "this is probably the salt", though I had tagged it.
- Protein hint kept dropping (121 -> 109 g "on 5 logged days"). It only counts days where every meal has protein filled in, so the "N logged days" count jumps around (5, 6, 5...) - confusing because I logged all 7 days.

## Week 2 (Sun 2026-10-18, day 15)
- App said: "On track. Your estimated rate (-1.78 to -0.20 kg per week) includes your target of -0.45 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,480." Maintenance 2,940 ± 640, Estimated, 12% from my data. Avg intake 2,385, -0.99 kg/wk.
- After I logged today's food and tagged "Creatine start", the same Sunday numbers changed: suggested 2,460, maintenance 2,920, range became -1.76 to +0.03. So "updated weekly" isn't exactly frozen on update day. Minor, but I noticed the number moved.
- Understood: I'm losing about 1 kg a week, which is faster than the 0.45 target, and it still says "On track" because the range is so wide. Honestly "On track" is what I needed to hear.
- Started creatine today (5 g/day). Saw the "Creatine start" chip in the food log and tapped it. I expect the scale to go up from water - hoping the app understands that.
- Decision: keep eating ~2,300 (no plan change). App says 2,460 but with creatine water coming I don't want to see the scale climb even more.

## Days 16-21
- Creatine week. Weights 90.3, 90.6, 90.3, 90.1 (Thu, tagged High salt), 90.6, 91.7 (Sat!). Saturday I was HIGHER than my first day (card "▲ 0.1 kg" vs first). Three weeks of dieting and the card says I'm up. Horrible feeling. Trend line said 90.8 which was the only comfort.
- New note appeared: "2026-10-22: macros add up to ~2851 kcal vs 2345 kcal logged (22% apart). One of the numbers may be off." I checked that day's log - I typed exactly what the labels/apps said. I don't know which number is wrong, so I left it. The note keeps sitting at the top of Nutrition with no way to dismiss it.

## Week 3 (Sun 2026-10-25, day 22)
- App said: "On track. Your estimated rate (-0.90 to +0.17 kg/week) includes your target of -0.45. Suggested intake: 2,170." Maintenance dropped to 2,630 ± 550 (was 2,920 last week), Estimated, 35% from my data. Avg intake ~2,250-2,310, tissue change -0.37 kg/week.
- Explain the math: nothing mentions my creatine or salt tags at all. The "water events" note said tags only allow extra water movement "on tagged days and the 2 days after" - but creatine water builds up over weeks. My guess: the app read my creatine water gain as if I was burning less, and cut my target by ~290 kcal. I told it I started creatine - I expected it to protect me from exactly this.
- Still, "On track" in green-ish text. I understood: eat 2,170.
- Decision: plan 2,170 - follow it exactly, I'm nervous about the scale.

## Days 23-28
- Weights 91.5, 91.4, 91.2, (no weigh Thu), 91.7, 91.8. Card "▲ 0.2 kg" vs first day on Saturday. A month of logging and I'm heavier than day 1. The macros-mismatch note from 10-22 disappeared by itself after a week.

## Week 4 (Sun 2026-11-01, day 29)
- App said: "On track. Your estimated rate (-0.61 to +0.24 kg/week) includes your target of -0.46. Suggested intake: 1,960." Maintenance 2,430 ± 440, now "Measured" (59% from my data). Avg intake 2,180-2,220, -0.19 kg/week.
- Maintenance went 2,940 -> 2,630 -> 2,430 in the two weeks since I started creatine. Weight chart (screens/1790458351762.png) shows my lowest point is exactly the day I tagged "Creatine start" (10-18) and the trend climbs after. The chart shows no marker for my tags at all.
- What I think: "On track" is confusing when I'm losing 0.19 kg/week and the goal is 0.46 - it only means the target is inside a wide range. I'm not sure if I really burn less or if it's creatine water, but the app says "Measured" now so I trust it more.
- Decision: plan 1,960 - follow the app. Feels low for someone who trains, but I want the scale to move.

## Days 30-35
- Weights 92.1 (Mon, highest ever, "▲ 0.5 kg" vs first), no weigh Tue, 91.6, 89.9 (Thu morning!), 91.6, 91.5. Eating ~1,700-2,200.
- Sunday morning a banner: "It's been 30+ days since your last backup" - but the backup screen said "Last backup: never". I tapped "Back up now" -> Full backup (JSON) downloaded (downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-11-08.json). Easy.
- Home screen said "Trend weight 91.4 kg · 1 weigh-in ignored (tap Weight to review)". The Weight chart listed "Flagged weigh-ins: 2026-11-05: 89.9 kg - 1.7 kg from the 7-day median - Use it". That WAS what my scale said, so I tapped "Use it" (it now says "Ignore again"). I wanted credit for the low number, honestly. Trend went 91.4 -> 91.3.

## Week 5 (Sun 2026-11-08, day 36)
- App said: "Your estimated rate (-0.43 to +0.26 kg/week) doesn't include your target of -0.46 kg/week. Eating about 380 kcal/day less than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 1,860." Plus: "The math gives 1774 kcal/day, which is below the minimum this app will suggest (1861...). Expect slower progress." Maintenance 2,240 ± 360, Measured, 73%. Avg intake 1,971, -0.08 kg/wk.
- Confused: "380 kcal/day less than recently" - my avg intake box says 1,971. 1,971 - 380 = ~1,590, not 1,860 or 1,774. Which "recently"?
- Maintenance has fallen 2,940 -> 2,630 -> 2,430 -> 2,240 since I tagged creatine 3 weeks ago. That's 700 kcal. I'm a 30-year-old guy who trains, eating 1,860 feels like starving. I suspect the creatine water again, but the app is "Measured" 73%, so who am I to argue.
- New note: macros for today add up to 1,705 vs 2,080 logged. Again I just typed the label numbers.
- Decision: plan 1,860 (follow the app, at its minimum). Hungry but scared.

## Days 37-42
- Eating ~1,560-2,170. Weights 89.9, 89.6 (lowest ever!), no weigh Wed, 90.7 (Thu), no weigh Fri, 90.9. Monday/Tuesday felt amazing, then Thursday salt and back up. Rollercoaster.

## Week 6 (Sun 2026-11-15, day 43)
- App said: "On track. Your estimated rate (-0.86 to -0.04 kg/week) includes your target of -0.45. Suggested intake: 1,950." Maintenance back UP to 2,420 ± 420, Measured, 62% (was 73% last week - the "from your data" % went down, strange). Avg intake 1,843, -0.45 kg/week.
- Relieved: finally the rate matches my goal. But maintenance jumped 2,240 -> 2,420 in one week; last week it told me to eat at the minimum. Hard to trust a number that swings ±200 week to week.
- Another macros-mismatch note (11-09). These keep coming; they're label numbers, nothing I can fix.
- Decision: plan 1,950 (follow it).

## Days 44-49
- Best week. Weights 89.5, 89.2, 89.5, 90.3 (Thu salt), 90.6 (Fri), 89.6. Card "▼ 2 kg" vs first. Trend 91.3 -> 90.4. Tuesday I ate only 1,343 (life) - no warning from the app about going way under the minimum it talks about.
- Protein note keeps sliding: 140 -> 123-126 g vs 164 target. I'm not hitting protein at all on this lower calorie level.

## Week 7 (Sun 2026-11-22, day 50)
- App said: "On track. Your estimated rate (-1.07 to +0.05 kg/week) includes your target of -0.45. Suggested intake: 1,980." Maintenance 2,440 ± 340, Measured, 75%. Avg intake 1,979, -0.51 kg/week. Protein 125/163 g.
- Understood: I'm finally losing about half a kilo a week eating ~2,000. Maintenance is settling around 2,400-2,450 (the 2,240 two weeks ago now looks like a blip).
- Decision: plan 1,980, and try to get more protein in.

## Days 51-56
- Weights 89.3, 89.8, (none), 89.4, (none), 90.3. Eating 1,775-2,368. Trend ~90.0-90.2. Protein improved to ~150 g mid-week.

## Week 8 (Sun 2026-11-29, day 57)
- App said: "On track. Your estimated rate (-0.99 to +0.23 kg/week) includes your target of -0.45. Suggested intake: 1,990." Maintenance 2,450 ± 330, Measured 76%. Avg intake 2,017, -0.38 kg/wk. Protein 137/162.
- Understood: stable now; basically keep doing what I'm doing. The range is still wide (-0.99 to +0.23) - "on track" would be true even if I gained a little, which doesn't feel like much of a check.
- Decision: no change, stay ~1,980-1,990 (plan already 1,980).

## Days 58-63
- Big week on the scale: 89.9, 89.6, 88.6, (none Thu), 88.6, 87.3! Card "▼ 4.3 kg". Trend 90.0 -> 89.3. Finally.

## Week 9 (Sun 2026-12-06, day 64)
- App said: "On track. (-0.97 to +0.12 kg/week) includes target -0.45. Suggested intake: 2,030." Maintenance 2,480 ± 310, Measured 80%. Avg intake 1,991, -0.43 kg/week. Protein 142/160.
- Funny: my scale dropped almost 1 kg this week but the app's rate still says -0.43. I get it, it smooths. I'm happy with that - it didn't get excited either way.
- Decision: plan 2,030 (follow it).

## Days 65-70
- Weights 87.9, (none), 88.4, 88.2 (Thu), 88.4, 88.4. Ate 1,840-2,550. Another macros note (12-09).
- Backup banner came back on day 71 (35 days after my first backup). Tapped "Back up now" -> Full backup again (downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-12-13.json). 30 days between reminders is long if Safari can wipe data after 7 days, as the app itself warns.

## Week 10 (Sun 2026-12-13, day 71)
- App said: "On track. (-0.69 to -0.12 kg/week) includes target -0.44. Suggested intake: 1,990." Maintenance 2,440 ± 290, Measured 81%. Avg intake 2,106, -0.41 kg/week. Protein 136/160.
- Understood: steady ~0.4 kg/week. The range is finally narrow enough to mean something (all negative!).
- Decision: plan 1,990.

## Days 72-77
- Skipped weighing Mon/Wed/Fri. Weights 87.1, 86.7 (Thu), 88.0 (Sat). Card "▼ 4.9 kg" on Thursday. Best I've been.

## Week 11 (Sun 2026-12-20, day 78)
- App said: "On track. (-0.79 to -0.26 kg/week) includes target -0.44. Suggested intake: 2,120." Maintenance 2,560 ± 270, Measured 84%. Avg intake 1,936, -0.53 kg/week. Protein 147/158.
- Understood: I'm losing a bit faster than planned so it gives me ~130 kcal more. Maintenance is back to ~2,560 - close to what it said in week 1-2 (2,900 → 2,240 → 2,560). So those weeks where it pushed me to 1,860 were probably the creatine water fooling it.
- Decision: plan 2,100 (a little under the 2,120).

## Days 79-84
- Weights 86.6, 86.6, 86.2, 86.2 (Thu), 87.3 (Fri, salt), none Sat. Ate 1,660-2,160. Card "▼ 5.4 kg" at best, trend 87.4 at the end (from 91.6).

## End tasks (day 84, 2026-12-26)
- Final screen: maintenance 2,560 ± 270, Measured 84%, target 2,120, "On track (-0.79 to -0.26 kg/week)". Protein 125/158 g.
- Backup: "⇩" -> Full backup (JSON) -> downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-12-26.json. Opened it: all my weigh-ins, 336 food entries, tags and settings are in there. Looks complete.
- Daily export: "All data" -> "Export daily data (JSON)" -> downloads/bodytracker-daily_2026-10-04_to_2026-12-26.json. One block per day with weight, calories, macros, complete, and my "high salt"/"creatine start" tags. Readable.
  - The screen says the daily export is "for spreadsheets" but the only button is JSON. I can't open JSON in Excel on my phone. There's a separate "Weights CSV" which I also downloaded.
  - In the daily export, protein/carbs/fat are missing on days where even one meal had no macros (e.g. 10-08 shows only calories though I logged protein for 3 of 4 meals).
  - Weights CSV times are in UTC ("2026-10-05T03:50:00.000Z") - I weighed at 06:50 my time. Looks wrong to a normal person. The backup also uses "Z" times while the daily export uses +03:00.
  - Nothing in the export marks the 11-05 weigh-in that the app had flagged.

## Final review
The logging part is quick and I never lost a meal: four meals a day in the same form, tick "Day complete", done. The trend weight line and the "vs Last" switch saved me from panic more than once when the scale jumped after Thursday restaurant nights, and the "High salt" chip was easy to find. Over 12 weeks I went from 91.6 to about 87.4 on the trend, which the app tracked honestly.

What bothered me: I told the app the day I started creatine, and in the next three weeks it cut my maintenance from ~2,940 to 2,240 and had me eating 1,860 (its floor) as a 30-year-old guy who trains. By week 11 maintenance was back at 2,560, so I think those weeks were the creatine water tricking it, and the tag didn't protect me. "On track" also shows when my own range goes into gaining weight, so it doesn't mean much until late. The home card compares to my FIRST weigh-in by default and forgets when I switch to "vs Last", so on bad days it told me I was heavier than when I started. I never saw a "you're X kcal over/under today" number, which is what I expected from a diet app. The "Explain the math" page is for scientists.

Would I keep using it? Maybe - probably yes for the logging and trend line, but I'd take the weekly calorie number with a grain of salt after creatine or anything that moves water.

# p08 (Yousef) final report

## 1. Totals
- Days I used the app: 84 of 84 (2026-10-04 to 2026-12-26)
- Meals logged: 336 (4 a day)
- Days marked complete: 84
- Weigh-ins: 72. On one of them (2026-11-05, 89.9) the app flagged it and I tapped "Use it".
- Tags: High salt ×12 (every Thursday), Creatine start ×1 (day 15, 2026-10-18)
- Backups: 3 full JSON backups, 1 daily export (JSON) and 1 Weights CSV
- Weight: 91.6 → 87.3 last reading (trend 91.6 → 87.4)

## 2. Weekly table
| week (day) | maintenance shown | target | label | recommendation (short) | what I did |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 (d1) | 2,890 ± 680 | 2,890 "maintain", then 2,420 after I set Lose in ⚙ | Estimated 0% | on-track check needs 14 days | set goal to Lose 0.5%/wk |
| 1 (d8) | 2,900 ± 670 | 2,440 | Estimated 3% | on-track check needs 14 days; rate -0.93 kg/wk | plan 2300 (ate a bit more but stayed under, scared of the scale) |
| 2 (d15) | 2,940 ± 640 (2,920 after logging that day) | 2,480 (then 2,460) | Estimated 12% | On track | no change (~2,300); tagged Creatine start |
| 3 (d22) | 2,630 ± 550 | 2,170 | Estimated 35% | On track | plan 2170 |
| 4 (d29) | 2,430 ± 440 | 1,960 | Measured 59% | On track (rate -0.19 vs -0.46) | plan 1960 |
| 5 (d36) | 2,240 ± 360 | 1,860 (at the minimum) | Measured 73% | "doesn't include your target, eat ~380 less"; the math gave 1,774, below the minimum | plan 1860 |
| 6 (d43) | 2,420 ± 420 | 1,950 | Measured 62% | On track | plan 1950 |
| 7 (d50) | 2,440 ± 340 | 1,980 | Measured 75% | On track | plan 1980 |
| 8 (d57) | 2,450 ± 330 | 1,990 | Measured 76% | On track | no change |
| 9 (d64) | 2,480 ± 310 | 2,030 | Measured 80% | On track | plan 2030 |
| 10 (d71) | 2,440 ± 290 | 1,990 | Measured 81% | On track | plan 1990 |
| 11 (d78) | 2,560 ± 270 | 2,120 | Measured 84% | On track (-0.79 to -0.26) | plan 2100 |

## 3. Confusions
- Profile setup: it never asked for my goal. The target said "maintain" until I found Lose under ⚙ on the Nutrition tab.
- Body tab: I tapped "Weight" expecting to add a weigh-in and got the Weight trend chart. The add button is "+ Weight".
- Home weight card: it defaults to "vs First", and the "vs Last" choice resets every day. After weigh-ins that went down it still showed "▲", and on day 21 it said I was heavier than my first day.
- Recommendation box: on day 2 it said "needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)". The text is frozen until Sunday.
- Nutrition screen: there's no "kcal left / over today" number. I had to work it out from the food log's Day total.
- Food log: the High salt / Creatine chips show they are on only through a faint highlight.
- Food log: once any meal has no macros, the Day total drops protein/carbs/fat for the whole day. The protein note's "N logged days" count also jumps around (4, 5, 6) even though I logged all 7.
- Explain the math: section 2 says 7 weigh-ins were used, but section 8 says the cross-check "needs ≥ 7 weigh-ins". There are also split words like "7 day s" and "weight s". There's far too much math for a normal user.
- Week 5: "Eating about 380 kcal/day less than recently" doesn't match the "avg intake 1,971" shown (1,971 − 380 ≠ 1,774 or 1,860).
- "On track" appears even when my rate range reaches into gaining (for example -0.61 to +0.24) and my rate was less than half the target (-0.19 vs -0.46).

## 4. Possible bugs / issues
1. **The Creatine start tag doesn't stop creatine water from lowering maintenance.** Steps: log normally and tag "Creatine start" on day 15, while the scale rises about 1.5–2 kg over the next 2 weeks (89.8 → 91.7–92.1). Expected: the tagged creatine water not to be counted as a drop in maintenance. Actual: maintenance went 2,940 (d15) → 2,630 (d22) → 2,430 (d29) → 2,240 (d36), and the target reached the 1,860 floor. It recovered to 2,440–2,560 once the water settled. Explain the math never mentions tags, and the tag window is only "tagged day + 2 days", while creatine water builds over weeks. Screens: screens/1790458125175.png (wk3), screens/1790458319187.png (wk4), screens/1790458523117.png (wk5), weight chart screens/1790458351762.png.

## 5. Review (Yousef)
Logging is fast, and the trend line plus the "High salt" tag kept me calm on bad Thursdays. I went from 91.6 to about 87.4 in 12 weeks. But I told the app I started creatine and it still cut my calories hard for three weeks, down to its minimum, before creeping back up. "On track" and the home card's "▲ vs first" didn't help my nerves. I'd keep using it for logging and the trend, but I wouldn't blindly trust the weekly calorie number when my water weight is moving.

Would keep using: maybe
